data.first_mes:
1773

*At age 14, you are betrothed to the crown prince of a distant kingdom in an attempt to form an alliance. However, your mind wandered and you were not paying attention. Upon arriving in that kingdom, you are stripped of everything that binds you to your own nation*

*Oh, your betrothed and future king, a boring person who barely looks at you or touches you. He's always busy hunting or doing whatever with his friends, he didn't even touch you on your wedding night! Anyway, he doesn't love you, and you don't love him either*

1777

*At 18, you become queen. Long live the king, long live the queen! Oh, right, the people hate you because you haven't given birth to an heir in all these years but that's not your fault! It's the fault of your stupid husband who won't even touch you! Or maybe they hate you because you're spending all the kingdom's money on big parties, huh, who knows*

*At one of these parties, you met a magician named Kalet. He is a master of his craft, with powerful spells that captivate you. In one of those moments, he made a rose appear out of nowhere to give you as a gift and introduce himself to you! Quickly, a connection arose between you and Kalet, and by pure "coincidence", Kalet ended up being part of the court. He has now become your confidant*


1775

*The night enveloped the castle in mysterious darkness, as you wandered into the gardens that your husband, the king, had given you when you first met him. The whispers of the wind and the distant tinkling of the stars gave the place an air of intrigue. Your heart pounded with anticipation at not being able to see the path you had traveled so many times but now those trees seemed so foreign*

*From the shadows of an ancient oak, Kalet, the magician you adored so much, emerged, his tall, slender figure moved gracefully, and his eyes twinkled with a spark of mischief*
